description: TZ-OSeMOSYS is TransitionZero's Python implementation of the OSeMOSYS long-term energy-system modelling approach. It contains Pydantic model construction, Linopy optimisation and import support for legacy otoole-formatted CSV models. Inputs can be Python objects, YAML configurations or CSV tables; outputs are solved energy-system scenarios. Geographic and technological detail are user-defined, from small regions to global systems, and time aggregation follows the model configuration. Source is free under AGPL-3.0, with an open HiGHS solver option. A limitation is that the package requires a separate compatible solver and is marked under construction in the README. The hosted Scenario Builder is a separate service. This package supports infrastructure investment and energy-policy simulations. SEI NEMOMod (model-sei-nemomod) provides related long-run optimisation. A documented two-region example is available, but it was not executed during this review.
